item.title: ConformTXT 0.6.7
item.description: - Fixed: in ONLYOFFICE and LibreOffice spreadsheets, a paste could land in the wrong cell. Spreadsheets (there, and in Excel and Numbers) now get their own normal paste, instantly. - For testing: Log to Desktop (right-click the menu bar icon). While it's on, every paste's full History line is written, as it happens, to "ConformTXT Log.txt" on your Desktop. Off by default; never includes what you copied.
